chunks: How was then My punishment and My commination!
ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'How was then My punishment' refer to in Surah Al-Qamar?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this rhetorical question highlights the overwhelming magnitude of divine retribution that surpasses human comprehension, serving as a stark contrast to the disbelievers' arrogance. It underscores the concept of 'Nuthur' (warning) not merely as a threat, but as a comprehensive manifestation of Allah's power that leaves no room for denial, particularly in the context of the Day of Judgment.
